title: Scott v. Harris (2007)
key_points: Holding: An officer's attempt to end a dangerous high-speed chase that threatens bystanders, even at risk of serious injury to the fleeing driver, can be reasonable.
officer_notes: Scenario: A driver leads police on a reckless chase at high speed through traffic, and an officer bumps his car to end it.
Takeaway: Follow the NJ AG Vehicular Pursuit Policy, which sharply limits pursuits and vehicle contact.
